(()=>{PT8.launch({rally:true,circuit:true,mode:'mp',track:PT8.RING_IDX,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});const T=RACE.T,out=[];for(let k=85;k<=89;k++)for(let f=0;f<1;f+=.25){const a=k,b=k+1,x0=T.x[a]+(T.x[b]-T.x[a])*f,z0=T.z[a]+(T.z[b]-T.z[a])*f,y0=T.y[a]+(T.y[b]-T.y[a])*f,ps=T.psi[a];const row=[k+f];for(const lat of[-5,-4.3,-3.5,0]){const x=x0+Math.cos(ps)*lat,z=z0-Math.sin(ps)*lat;const s=T.surf(x,z,y0+1);row.push(+(s.h-y0).toFixed(2),s.i)}out.push(row)}return JSON.stringify({hw:T.hw[87],out,br:!!T.br,gap:T.gap?T.gap[87]:null})})()
